mapper.select: SELECT A.SEQ , A.EMP_ID , A.PASS , A.CUST_CODE , A.EMP_GRADE , A.USE_TYPE , A.JOIN_DATE , A.EMP_NAME , A.DEPT_GRADE , A.DEPT_NAME , A.EMAIL , A.TEL_NO , B.CUST_KOR_NAME FROM CRM_CUST_ERP A INNER JOIN CRM_CUST_MGT B ON A.CUST_CODE = B.CRM_CODE WHERE A.EMP_ID = #{emp_id, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT A.SEQ , A.EMP_ID , A.CUST_CODE , A.EMP_GRADE , A.USE_TYPE , A.JOIN_DATE , A.EMP_NAME , A.DEPT_GRADE , A.DEPT_NAME , A.EMAIL , A.TEL_NO , B.CUST_KOR_NAME FROM CRM_CUST_ERP A INNER JOIN CRM_CUST_MGT B ON A.CUST_CODE = B.CRM_CODE WHERE A.EMP_NAME = #{emp_name, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.EMAIL = #{email, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT A.SEQ , A.EMP_ID , A.CUST_CODE , A.EMP_GRADE , A.USE_TYPE , A.JOIN_DATE , A.EMP_NAME , A.DEPT_GRADE , A.DEPT_NAME , A.EMAIL , A.TEL_NO , B.CUST_KOR_NAME FROM CRM_CUST_ERP A INNER JOIN CRM_CUST_MGT B ON A.CUST_CODE = B.CRM_CODE WHERE A.EMP_ID = #{emp_id, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.EMP_NAME = #{emp_name, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.EMAIL = #{email, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT IN_TB.* FROM ( SELECT A.* , ROWNUM RNUM FROM (select * from crm_menu_mgt where menu_code in ( select menu_code from crm_role_menu rm, crm_role_user ru where ru.ROLE_CODE = rm.ROLE_CODE and ru.EMP_NO = #{emp_no} ) ) A START WITH MENU_CODE = '0000' CONNECT BY PRIOR MENU_CODE = P_MENU_CODE ) IN_TB WHERE IN_TB.MENU_CODE != '0000' ORDER BY IN_TB.RNUM

SELECT DISTINCT TB.* FROM ( SELECT PROG_CODE FROM CRM_ROLE_PROG WHERE ROLE_CODE IN (SELECT ROLE_CODE FROM CRM_ROLE_USER WHERE EMP_NO = #{emp_no})
UNION ALL
SELECT MENU_URL AS PROG_CODE FROM CRM_MENU_MGT WHERE MENU_CODE IN ( SELECT MENU_CODE FROM CRM_ROLE_MENU RM, CRM_ROLE_USER RU WHERE RU.ROLE_CODE = RM.ROLE_CODE AND RU.EMP_NO = #{emp_no} ) AND MENU_URL IS NOT NULL ) TB
SELECT EMP_NO, ROLE_CODE, REG_ID, REG_DATE, UPD_ID, UPD_DATE FROM CRM_ROLE_USER WHERE EMP_NO = #{emp_no}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COME_ON_USER (C_DATE, C_ID, C_CUST, C_TYPE) VALUES(SYSDATE,#{emp_id},#{cust_code},#{weight})
